title: Scorched Bottle
description: If you scorch a bottle, it becomes a "Scorched Bottle".
body:
# 炙りビン / Scorched Bottle / 炙烤药瓶 / 병 구이

> 「ビンを炙ったら、【炙りビン】になるよ！」
> 
> "If you scorch a bottle, it becomes a '**Scorched Bottle**'!"

このModが追加するのはただ一つだけ、それは【**炙りビン**】。

This mod adds exactly one thing:
**a bottle that has been scorched**.

# Item

かまど、もしくは焚き火を用いて作成できます。

Can be crafted using a Furnace or a Campfire.

![炙りビンのレシピ / scorched bottle recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0bd9671d5457abbe8cf78679b39174873a71fb6a.png)

注意 : 食べるとケガします。

Caution : Eating this item will hurt you.

# About Translation

Supported Laungage : 日本語(JP) / English(EN) / 简体中文(ZH-CN) / 한국어(KO)

The creator is Japanese, and all in-game text uses machine translation. 
If you find any mistakes, please report them via the Issue link.

# About This Mod

このModは[魔法少女ノ魔女裁判](https://manosaba.com/)に影響を受けて制作されたもので、
[配信・二次創作ガイドライン](https://manosaba.com/guidelines)に従っています。

もちろん非公式です。

This mod was created in respect of the game "Magical Girl Witch Trials".

It was created in accordance with the game's streaming and fan content guidelines.

This project is not affiliated with the original creators.
